event.title: Minicor was accepted into Y Combinator P26
event.summary: So so incredibly grateful to share that Minicor (YC P26) (formerly Laminar) has been accepted into Y Combinator's upcoming Spring 2026 batch working with Tom Blomfield as our GP alongside Kulveer Taggar.
